Team 1 is at the bottom of the screen, Team 2 at the top.
• Swipe DOWN to increase Team 1 score.
• Swipe UP to increase Team 2 score.
You can undo scoring if a mistake is made - back to the beginning of the match if needed.
Match time is tracked automatically. You can pause, restart, and stop the match timer. Stopping the match timer ends the match early (the match is abandoned).
